title: Low carb
summary: Fewer starches and sugars, more protein, vegetables and healthy fats.
description: Meals built on protein, non-starchy vegetables and healthy fats, with no more than about a quarter of their energy from carbohydrates. It is a moderate low-carb plan, not keto. Some people find it easier to eat less this way; in long trials it works about as well as other diets, so pick it if it suits you.
highlights: At most a quarter of energy from carbs
Not keto: fruit and some starch stay
caution: On diabetes medicine, especially insulin, a sulphonylurea (such as gliclazide) or an SGLT2 inhibitor (such as dapagliflozin or empagliflozin)? Talk to your doctor before cutting carbs: your doses may need to change. Not for pregnancy or breastfeeding without advice.
